scientific_integrity: Written all-size algebraic proof; executable finite integer enumeration supports but does not replace proof. Findings report priority uncertainty and do not claim independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Full occupancy, unweighted complete bipartite graphs and one-dimensional absolute types only.
Only bilateral swaps that strictly lower both agents' average-distance costs are permitted.
The potential-maximizing allocation and social-cost-minimizing allocation are not generally identical.
No independent publication-priority audit or validation has been performed.
title: Rank-rounded optimization and sharp efficiency boundaries in continuous-type Schelling bicliques
